messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - TLS handshake failures observed for multiple customer-facing endpoints in us-east-1. Incident id=net-tls-8034. Paging SRE + NetOps. Please acknowledge.

maya: acknowledged, I'm on call. Observing ~33% TLS handshake failures starting ~08:10 UTC. Failures concentrated on the us-east edge fleet. Tagging @diego (infra), @irina (certs), @ben (netops).

diego: joining. Any cert rotations or config pushes overnight?

irina: we ran an automated rotation at 01:02 UTC via cert-rotator v2.6. Rotation reported success but the packager logged "chain order anomaly" at 08:06 UTC. No rollback occurred.

zara: customer probes started failing at 08:08. Sample curl from canary probe: 
```
curl -Iv https://api.redwood.internal/health
* Connected to 10.12.21.33 (10.12.21.33) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake error: SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert decrypt error
* Closing connection 0
```

ben: external LB health checks show "handshake_failure" and sometimes "certificate verify failed". I'm seeing some nodes return an unexpected certificate (CN mismatch) intermittently.

maya: hypothesis A: cert artifact missing intermediate or wrong SANs deployed to subset of ingress pods (partial rollout). Hypothesis B: transient routing (BGP peering flaps) redistributed traffic to bad replicas during rotation. Hypothesis C: MTU/fragmentation causing truncated ClientHello - lower confidence.

sre-lead: collect packet captures and envoy logs. Prioritize fast rollback if certs are bad.

netbot: network telemetry: BGP session events between vpc-prod-us-east and vpc-platform at 08:05:50 and 08:06:58. Posting logs: 
``
08:05:50 BGP: session vpc-platform state change DOWN
08:05:52 BGP: session vpc-platform state change UP
08:06:58 BGP: session vpc-platform state change DOWN
08:07:01 BGP: session vpc-platform state change UP
```

diego: listing secrets in ingress namespace shows two active versions: cert-primary-0326 and cert-primary-0326-legacy; a number of pods reference the -legacy variant which seems to lack the intermediate cert.

irina: confirming packager logs: when CA returned chain in order [leaf, root, intermediate] our bundler concatenated without normalizing order, dropping the intermediate in some artifact paths. This is a packaging bug in cert-rotator v2.6.

diego: tcpdump from ingress-21 (affected): 
```
08:09:58.101234 IP 10.12.21.33.54001 > 10.12.25.9.443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0
08:09:58.101567 IP 10.12.25.9.443 > 10.12.21.33.54001: Flags [S.], seq 0, ack 1, win 28960, length 0
08:09:58.101900 IP 10.12.21.33.54001 > 10.12.25.9.443: Flags [P.], seq 1:1450, ack 1, win 64240, length 1449
08:09:58.102020 IP 10.12.25.9.443 > 10.12.21.33.54001: Flags [R], seq 0, ack 0, win 0, length 0
```
RST right after ClientHello packet.

zara: envoy log from the same pod: 
```
[2026-03-26T08:09:58Z] warn tls: handshake failed: no matching certificate for requested name \"api.redwood.internal\"
[2026-03-26T08:09:58Z] error connection: rejecting client; cert chain incomplete
```

irina: running openssl s_client on the pod to validate chain: 
```
$ openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:8443 -servername api.redwood.internal -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.redwood.internal
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
0 s:/CN=api.redwood.internal
  i:/CN=redwood-root
---
```
Intermediate missing.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) identify pods with broken secret, 2) replace secret with verified full-chain bundle, 3) restart envoy on affected pods, 4) if issues persist, shift critical customer routes to standby region. Diego to run targeted fix, Irina to pause rotations and prepare hotfix. Ben to open cloud ticket for BGP logs.

diego: running targeted secret replacement for ingress-21 and ingress-25 now and performing rolling restarts. Script used: 
```bash
kubectl get pods -n ingress -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.volumes[]?.secret.name=="cert-primary-0326-legacy") | .metadata.name'
# patch secret with full-bundle and restart envoy
```

ben: confirming: after restart health checks from external probes start to return 200s at ~08:18 UTC. Error rate falls steadily.

netbot: archived capture: s3://redwood-incidents/1975312468/raw-captures.tar.gz (internal)

maya: status update for customers: we replaced incorrect certificate bundles on affected nodes and restarted proxies; traffic recovery in progress. ETA to full recovery 20-30 minutes while we validate across the fleet. PMs please share to support.

pm-elena: posting to support channel now. Will notify top-tier customers with a short blurb.

sre-lead: hypothesis review: H1 (cert packaging bug) 1 supported by packager logs, secret diff, openssl trace. H2 (BGP flaps) 1 supported by timing alignment between BGP flaps and error spike; likely exacerbated exposure during rotation. H3 (MTU) 1 unsupported by current evidence. Mark H1 primary, H2 contributing.

irina: in-thread RCA notes to include in postmortem draft: 
- 01:02 UTC: cert-rotator v2.6 completed rotation; packager did not normalize chain order for certain CA responses.
- 08:05-08:07 UTC: BGP session flaps observed between vpc-prod-us-east and vpc-platform, which redistributed traffic.
- 08:09-08:10 UTC: clients start seeing TLS handshake failures; some ingress pods serving incomplete chains returned RSTs after ClientHello.
- 08:12-08:18 UTC: targeted secret replacement and proxy restarts for affected pods.
- 08:18-08:38 UTC: healthchecks recover and error rate returns to baseline.

sre-lead: immediate action items (owner, ETA):
1) Patch cert-rotator bundler to normalize chain order and always include intermediates; add unit/integration tests (owner: irina, ETA 24h).
2) Add deploy preflight that runs openssl s_client with SNI against a canary pod before rolling out cert changes (owner: diego, ETA 12h).
3) Add staged rollout guard that pauses rollout if network instability detected (owner: maya, ETA 48h).
4) Open case with cloud provider for BGP flaps and request detailed logs and mitigation (owner: ben, ETA 72h).
5) Update runbook with quick rollback and validation steps including sample tcpdump/envoy snippets (owner: irina, ETA 6h).

diego: executing step 2 now; I'll push a PR with the preflight script and paste link here.

maya: handing on-call to @diego at 10:00 UTC. Leaving detailed notes and links to archived artifacts.

diego: taking watch. I'll follow up tomorrow with PR link and tracker items.

pm-elena: customers acknowledged update. Support will follow up for the handful of persistent mobile cases.

incident-bot: Incident net-tls-8034 status changed to RESOLVED at 08:40 UTC. Duration 30m. Incident record: https://incident.redwood/internal/1975312468

netbot: final archive uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/1975312468/final-archive.tar.gz (internal-only)

sre-lead: good work team. Ensure all action items are entered in tracker and schedule a follow-up with cloud provider. Capture logs and evidence for postmortem.

irina: I will open the hotfix PR for the bundler and link it here once green.

(08:40 UTC) maya: marking resolved. Drafting postmortem & will include timeline and hypothesis table."
